snippet.title: Legendary Tales - Dawn of History DLC | VR Games Showcase March 2026
snippet.description:
Legendary Tales Dawn of History DLC is now out on SteamVR and PS VR2: https://linktr.ee/UrbanWolfGames

Legendary tales is a VR action role-playing game with up to 4 player co-op. Collect items, enhance your abilities and fight your way through an ever-changing dungeon to make your own Legendary Tales.
